title: agrostis borealis subsp. hyperborea
intro: Agrostis borealis subsp. hyperborea, commonly known as Arctic Bentgrass or Hyperborean Bentgrass, is a subspecies of grass native to the Arctic tundra. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential health benefits such as wound healing, reduced inflammation, and protection against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis borealis subsp. hyperborea include its ability to soothe skin irritations, promote tissue repair, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
